deviations_from_card: (1) pages may not import pages (eslint boundaries), so simulator/cells.ts could not be read from characters: its counting core (THIN_N, ruleEntries, ruleFails, rulePass, notProvoked, notEvaluable, cellChecks, isRedLine) moved verbatim to new kit/cellCounts.ts and cells.ts re-exports it unchanged - still one home, no third held derivation, counts only. (2) The per-tone red-line count field is `redLine`, not `redLineFails` (name banned by the simulator source guard). (3) New tests live in new tones.test.tsx because layer2.test.tsx would exceed check-size's 400-line limit; the preview lives in new TonePreview.tsx (with the record line, to avoid an import cycle). (4) A lazy preview chunk (coordinator request) was tried: check-bundle refuses an unnamed dynamic chunk and scripts/check-bundle.mjs is a sibling's file, so it is static. (5) Pick persistence across tabs is an in-memory per-character store in evidence.ts (tournamentPick, with reset() for tests), same pattern as ui/tableView.
